Project: Insurance Charges Analysis

Objective:
Analyze factors affecting medical insurance charges and identify important features using statistical methods.

Tech Stack:
- Python
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Seaborn
- Matplotlib
- SciPy

Techniques Used:
- Data Cleaning
- EDA
- Correlation Analysis
- Chi-Square Testing
- Feature Engineering
- Feature Selection

Results:
Smoking status, age, and BMI were found to be among the most influential factors affecting insurance charges.
